name: Devonshire-Reseda Shopping Center
demographics: Devonshire Reseda Shopping Center serves the Northridge community in the San Fernando Valley, attracting middle-class families and working professionals with median household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $85,000. The primary trade area draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with a diverse demographic mix including young families, established homeowners aged 35-65, and a significant Hispanic population. Visitors typically seek convenient daily needs shopping, casual dining options, and essential services within a neighborhood setting, with shopping patterns focused on weekly grocery runs, fitness activities, and quick-service dining rather than destination retail experiences.
description: Devonshire Reseda Shopping Center is a neighborhood shopping destination conveniently located at the corner of Devonshire Street and Reseda Boulevard in Northridge, California. Serving the community with passion and pride, this center has established itself as a reliable hub for daily needs and lifestyle services in the San Fernando Valley. The shopping center offers a carefully curated mix of essential retailers, financial services, and a top-notch health club that caters to the fitness-conscious residents of the area. Dining options range from casual eateries to quality cuisine restaurants, providing variety for every taste and occasion. With its accessible location and practical tenant mix, Devonshire Reseda Shopping Center continues to be a valued community resource for Northridge residents seeking convenience and quality in their everyday shopping and dining experiences.
summary: Devonshire Reseda Shopping Center is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination in Northridge offering daily needs stores, financial services, a quality health club, and diverse dining options from casual to cuisine. Located at the corner of Devonshire Street and Reseda Boulevard, the center serves the community with a practical mix of essential services and restaurants.
